variant_decisions.evidence: Ketiv ויושיביני and qere וַיּוֹשִׁיבַנִי carry the same lemma (3427) and the same morphology (HC/Vhw3ms/Sp1cs); the difference is orthographic. ASV "and set me on the throne of David my father" renders both identically and carries no mapped textual note here, so nothing in the target distinguishes the readings. Retain the qere base that MACULA projects.
